svg.title: People living on less than $1.25 a day, 1990 and 2015
svg.desc: Two bars. In 1990, 1.9 billion people lived on less than $1.25 a day; in 2015, 836 million. A side panel notes that China alone saw a drop of 470 million, almost half of the global decline. A note adds that the pandemic later pushed up to 60 million people back into extreme poverty.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
